attributes.title: Level 7

subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓Did you use the documentation for help with using the tools in the animation paint editor to match the Player sprite’s animations to the direction that it’s moving in?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ What might be added to the walkLeftAnim and walkRightAnim assets to show the Player sprite bobbing and changing steps as it moves?


Solution:

Two more frames should be added to the walkLeftAnim and walkRightAnim assets to show the progression of the sprite’s walk. The second frame should show both of the sprite’s legs, with its body slightly shorter than the first frame. The third frame should show the sprite at full height, with its 2 legs visible.


Ask the ninja: 

❓ What direction should the frames in the flyRightAnim asset be facing?


Solution:

The horizontal flip tool should be used to horizontally flip each of the frames in the flyRightAnim asset, so that the ninja sprite is facing right instead of left.


Ask the ninja: 

❓ What code might be used to stop the sprite’s down animation?


Solution:

An on down button released event should be added to the project that stops all animation and sets the sprite’s image to the forwardNinja asset.
steps.instructions:
Use the animation paint editor to modify original pixel art animations in the project!


The Player sprite should have a left and right walking animation which shows it bobbing and changing feet as it moves.


When the Player sprite is flying, its animation should match the direction that it’s moving in.


Once the Player sprite returns to the ground, its down animation should stop. 


Use the tools in the animation paint editor and the code menu to modify the Player sprite’s animation!

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 7 of Brown Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about using still images to create animation assets. Different frames can be combined in the animation paint editor to animate a sprite’s movement in many different ways. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 7:

badges.title: I Like to Move It, Move It
badges.description: Use a variety of animation techniques to add movement to pixel art images in a project.

badges.title: Take it for a Spin
badges.description: Create animation assets that give the illusion of a sprite rotating or spinning.

badges.title: Boing!
badges.description: Create animation assets using squash and stretch that give the illusion of a sprite bouncing.

badges.title: Loafin’ Around
badges.description: Create an idle animation for a sprite.

badges.title: Frame by Frame
badges.description: Create animation assets that mimic the realistic movement of objects.

badges.title: It’s Alive!
badges.description: Use different layers to display an animation asset between 2 image assets.
